traits.name: Forensic Method
traits.result_text: Carried intact: it orders what is perceived into a case.

traits.name: Institutional Standing
traits.result_text: Carried: official rank is what lets a reading be recorded and acted upon.

traits.name: Standing Boundary
traits.result_text: Carried as a hard bound: outside the institutions that grant standing, a reading carries no weight.

traits.name: Artificial Companions
traits.result_text: Working among artificial persons becomes a known blind spot: they leave no residue, and the user learns to look for the gaps they leave.

traits.name: Guarded Composure
traits.result_text: Carried: a reading is kept to the facts, with no performance.

traits.name: Sidearm Competence
traits.reason: A combat skill the authored rule does not use.

traits.name: Soul Perception
traits.result_text: Perception of the living becomes perception of what the living leave behind.

traits.name: Soul Resonance
traits.reason: Resonance needs a partner and an attack to amplify; this ability is investigative and is never an attack.

traits.name: Partner Dependence
traits.reason: The limitation belongs to partner resonance, which is not carried.

traits.name: Weapon Partnership
traits.result_text: The partner's role as a channel that shapes and focuses energy becomes an instrument: a palm-sized crescent magnifier that focuses the reading. The partner as a person is not carried.

traits.name: Anti-Demon Calling
traits.reason: A hunting role; this ability is investigative, not a hunt.

traits.name: Disciplined Study
traits.result_text: Carried: reading traces is learned, methodical work.

emergent_ability.name: Residual Reading
emergent_ability.description: At a scene, the user reads the faint residue souls leave behind and orders it, by forensic method, into a timeline of who was present and in what state, recorded as evidence for a case.

governing_rule.description: Soul perception is turned from the living to what they leave behind: faint residues of recent presence are read at a scene and ordered by forensic method into a sequence of who was there and in what state, recorded as evidence for a case and bounded by the user's official standing.

emergent_ability.activation: Quiet, undisturbed time at the scene, with perception turned to what is left behind.
limitations: Residue fades: traces older than a short window cannot be read, and a disturbed scene is partly lost.
It records presence and state, not intent or guilt; a reading is evidence to be weighed, never a verdict.
Artificial persons leave no residue, so anyone or anything without a soul is invisible to it.
A reading carries weight only where the user has official standing; outside it, it is an unsupported claim.
Overlapping traces are slow, demanding work and leave the user drained.

inherited_limitations.name: Standing Boundary
inherited_limitations.description: Her authority exists only inside the city's institutions; beyond them it carries no weight.

exclusions.item: the closed city and its politics
exclusions.reason: Setting and politics, not a mechanic.
A lineage role, not a mechanic.

exclusions.item: the literal weapon partner as a carried companion
exclusions.reason: A separate person; only the partner's channel-shaping role is carried, as an instrument.

exclusions.item: the academy setting and its hierarchy
exclusions.reason: Setting and institution, not a mechanic.
